_comment: Shops to search. None of these grocers has a usable public price API for Canada (the US-only SerpApi/Scavio Walmart APIs do not cover walmart.ca), and direct page fetches are blocked by bot defenses. Each shop is searched with WebSearch and the website search URL below is used to build the buy link. For structured data behind bot-walls, use a browser-automation tool (see references/shop-apis.md).

api.notes: No documented API; parse the page's embedded __NEXT_DATA__ JSON. Plain curl/WebFetch blocked (418 Akamai TLS fingerprint); reach it with curl_cffi impersonate=chrome (no browser). Use scripts/walmart_search.py search|product. Search is headless; product pages need a homepage warm-up (script does it) and can occasionally hit a Press-&-Hold challenge -> fall back to headed browser. nutritionFacts often null (use USDA); ingredients/specs populated. SerpApi/Scavio Walmart APIs are US-only. See references/shop-apis.md.

Internal Magento GraphQL (no auth, CAD). Blocked to plain curl by Akamai TLS fingerprinting (403); reach it with curl_cffi impersonate=chrome (no browser/proxy). Use scripts/tnt_graphql.py search|product|images. Price/availability are store-scoped via request headers (GTA default; override --store-code/--postcode). BEST source of the three grocers. Nutrition is image-only, not structured (script's images cmd → vision OCR). See references/shop-apis.md.
No public API. Many items are warehouse-only and not listed online; treat online results as a subset.
